notes.title: Patch Notes For 2024-09-15 (2)
notes.content:
[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added some commands: /help, /kill, /resetspawnpoint
[/list]
[b]Reworks[/b]
[list]
[*] A player can no longer sleep in an underground layer.
[/list]
[b]Fixed bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare null exception occurring when a creature is attacking.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the player to teleport in water when returning from an underground layer which the player was respawned in.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes For 2024-09-15
notes.content:
[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added gold armor.
[/list]

[b]Reworks[/b]
[list]
[*] Buffed all knowledges (abilities).
[*] Increased chance to find knowledges (abilities) in chests.
[*] Decreased chance to find magic orbs for enchantment.
[*] Buffed enchantments.
[*] Small rework of loot tables for enemies and chests.
[*] Decreased time for Slime enemy to explode and added an explosion animation.
[/list]

[b]Fixed bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] The game would not pause when entering menu.
[*] Fixed incorrect recipe for items in the tutorial.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the player from placing bee hives.
[*] Fixed an issue where disenchanting an item gives the incorrect enchantment.
[*] Added a background image to the map.
[/list]
